cases.description: Inline Markdown contributes its visible text, without delimiters, URLs or images (step 1): `` ## `code` `` gives `code`.
Inline Markdown contributes its visible text, without delimiters, URLs or images (step 1): `` ## Use `foo` here `` gives `use-foo-here`.

Inline Markdown contributes its visible text, without delimiters, URLs or images (step 1): `` ## Operator `->` arrow `` gives `operator---arrow`.
`*` and `_` emphasis give the same text, so `## An _emphasised_ word` after `## An *emphasised* word` is a repeat and gives `an-emphasised-word-1` (steps 1 and 7).
`**` and `__` give the same text, so `## A __strong__ word` after `## A **strong** word` is a repeat and gives `a-strong-word-1` (steps 1 and 7).
